# Vtiger

> Vtiger is an AI-powered, all-in-one CRM platform trusted by 400,000+ businesses for sales automation, pipeline management, and customer relationship management.

Vtiger offers a comprehensive suite of CRM tools including sales pipeline management, deal tracking, contact management, and workflow automation. The platform features NextGen, an AI-native composable architecture that enables custom app building and AI activation for modern sales teams.

## Key Topics

- Vtiger CRM
